title: Medicare Part D Coordination — PrairieRx Dual Wrap
content:
**Coordination of benefits note, Pharmacy Benefit.** For a PrairieRx Dual Wrap member Medicare Part D pays first: a drug Part D covers is rejected with the reject reason "not covered — Medicare Part D", and only drugs Part D excludes, such as covered OTC drugs and prescription vitamins, are paid by Medicaid. Part D premiums and copays are never paid from the pharmacy benefit.

### Who pays

| Drug presented for a PrairieRx Dual Wrap member | Paid by |
|---|---|
| A drug Medicare Part D covers | Not paid by the Pharmacy Benefit; rejected as covered by Medicare Part D |
| A drug Part D excludes (for example a covered OTC drug or a prescription vitamin) | The Pharmacy Benefit (Medicaid) |

| Cost | Paid from the Pharmacy Benefit |
|---|---|
| Medicare Part D premium | Never |
| Medicare Part D copay | Never |

### Scope

This coordination applies to PrairieRx Dual Wrap, the one PrairieRx plan on which Part D pays first. On the other PrairieRx plans the Pharmacy Benefit is not secondary to Part D.
